body:
### Summary

Environment:
OS: macOS 26.6.2 (Build 25G83), (Apple Silicon, ARM64) 
uv 0.12.7 (Homebrew 2026-08-27 aarch64-apple-darwin)
uv Binary Path: Homebrew installation (/opt/homebrew/bin/uv)
opencode 1.18.25
Execution Context: Spawned as a child process via host app (opencode) without PTY allocated.

Description:
Executing uvx mcp-server-git directly in an interactive shell works fine. However, when uvx is spawned programmatically as a subprocess by an external host (where standard I/O streams are piped without a TTY), uv crashes with a native Rust panic in a Tokio worker thread:

Exception Type:  EXC_CRASH (SIGABRT)
Exception Codes: 0x0000000000000000, 0x0000000000000000
Termination Reason: Namespace SIGNAL, Code 6, Abort trap: 6
Terminating Process: uv

Thread 1 Crashed:: main2
0   libsystem_kernel.dylib         0x1816e45e8 __pthread_kill + 8
1   libsystem_pthread.dylib        0x18171f8d8 pthread_kill + 296
2   libsystem_c.dylib              0x181625978 abort + 148
...

Steps to Reproduce:
Spawn uvx <package> via child_process.spawn() / posix_spawn() in Node/Python without allocating a pseudo-terminal (pty: false).
Pipe stdin and stdout for IPC/JSON-RPC messaging.
Observe uv crashing immediately with SIGABRT / Abort trap 6 instead of gracefully running in headless mode.
Expected Behavior:
uvx should detect non-interactive pipe contexts, disable TTY progress/console reporters, and delegate stdio cleanly to the underlying target process without throwing an unhandled panic.

### Platform

macOS 26.6.2 (Build 25G83), Darwin 25.6.0 arm64

### Version

uv 0.12.7 (Homebrew 2026-08-27 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.12.9
title: uvx crashes with SIGABRT / abort() on macOS when launched non-interactively via subprocess stdio piping
